response.rationale: Annular plaques, anti-SSA/SSB positivity, and neutrophilic interface dermatitis favor subacute cutaneous lupus; discoid lupus typically shows scarring, follicular plugging, and positive DIF, which are absent here.

rejected.why: Lacks classic discoid features (scarring, follicular plugging) and DIF is negative; histology with neutrophils is more consistent with SCLE.
